description: This file implements AWS Bedrock integration for Large Language Model services, including context management, streaming inference, and response handling with support for function calls, images, and metrics.

classes.name: AWSBedrockContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Container for AWS Bedrock context aggregators, providing access to user and assistant aggregators.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMContext
classes.description: AWS Bedrock-specific extension of OpenAILLMContext, handling message format conversions and restructuring.

classes.name: AWSBedrockUserContextAggregator
classes.description: Aggregator for user messages in AWS Bedrock format (deprecated).

classes.name: AWSBedrockAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: Aggregator for assistant responses and function calls in AWS Bedrock format, including handling of function call states and user images.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMService
classes.description: Implementation of LLMService for AWS Bedrock, supporting inference, streaming, context creation, and metrics.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator.

methods.name: assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator.

methods.name: upgrade_to_bedrock
methods.description: Upgrades an OpenAILLMContext to AWSBedrockLLMContext.

methods.name: from_openai_context
methods.description: Creates AWSBedrockLLMContext from an OpenAILLMContext.

methods.name: from_messages
methods.description: Creates AWSBedrockLLMContext from a list of messages.

methods.name: set_messages
methods.description: Sets messages and restructures for Bedrock format.

methods.name: to_standard_messages
methods.description: Converts AWS Bedrock message format to standard format.

methods.name: from_standard_message
methods.description: Converts standard message to AWS Bedrock format.

methods.name: add_image_frame_message
methods.description: Adds an image message to the context.

methods.name: add_message
methods.description: Adds a message, merging with previous if same role.

methods.name: _restructure_from_bedrock_messages
methods.description: Restructures messages in AWS Bedrock format, handling system messages and merging.

methods.name: _restructure_from_openai_messages
methods.description: Restructures messages from OpenAI format, merging consecutive messages.

methods.name: get_messages_for_persistent_storage
methods.description: Returns messages formatted for persistent storage, including system message.

methods.name: get_messages_for_logging
methods.description: Returns messages formatted for logging with sensitive data redacted.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates AWS Bedrock-specific context aggregators for user and assistant (deprecated).

methods.name: _create_no_op_tool
methods.description: Creates a no-op tool for AWS Bedrock when tools are missing but required.

methods.name: _get_llm_invocation_params
methods.description: Generates invocation parameters from context.

methods.name: _process_context
methods.description: Handles streaming inference, response processing, and metrics collection.

methods.name: _estimate_tokens
methods.description: Estimates token count for a given text.

methods.name: _report_usage_metrics
methods.description: Reports token usage metrics.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes frames for context updates and inference.
